channel.title: AI Daily Watch: Microsoft Copilot & Microsoft 365
channel.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, Copilot Studio and agents, the consumer Copilot app, Copilot in Windows and Edge, and Copilot+ PCs.

item.title: Microsoft 365 outage disrupts Copilot Chat and other services
item.description: Microsoft: A widespread Microsoft 365 service disruption affected Copilot Chat, with users potentially unable to load chats or receive responses in web and desktop apps. Microsoft reported ongoing recovery work and gradual restoration of affected infrastructure; the cited updates described service recovery as still in progress.

item.title: Microsoft announces plugin discovery in Copilot and a public Plugin Catalog
item.description: Microsoft: Microsoft says plugins will begin appearing in Copilot navigation, making familiar agents easier to find as Copilot Home brings Chat and Cowork together. It also announced a public Plugin Catalog, planned to launch at Microsoft Ignite on November 17, giving users another way to discover Microsoft’s plugin ecosystem.

item.title: KPMG to expand Microsoft Copilot access across its global workforce
item.description: Microsoft: KPMG member firms will expand Microsoft Copilot access across a global workforce of more than 276,000 professionals, including KPMG in Thailand. KPMG will also use Microsoft Agent 365 to manage and monitor AI agents, making this a significant enterprise deployment and governance development.

item.title: Microsoft corrects Copilot Business nonprofit pricing in the December price-list preview
item.description: Microsoft: Microsoft disclosed that the December price-list preview had incorrect pricing for the Microsoft 365 Copilot Business nonprofit offer, and says the corrected preview was republished on November 9. Partners who accessed the earlier version are advised to download the updated price list; the notice does not specify the corrected amount.

item.title: Microsoft details Copilot Business and Copilot Studio partner promotions
item.description: Microsoft: Microsoft’s November partner update details promotional Copilot offers, including up to 15% off eligible new Copilot Business add-on subscriptions and 25% off the Business Basic plus Copilot Business bundle through December 31, 2026. It also describes an E7 plus annual Copilot Studio capacity pack Buy 5 Get 5 offer and eligible nonprofit Copilot discounts of up to 40%; terms and eligibility apply.

item.title: Auto SR launches on ROG XBOX Ally devices and expands to AMD-powered Copilot+ PCs
item.description: Microsoft: Microsoft brought Auto SR out of preview on the ROG XBOX Ally X and X20 and expanded availability to select AMD Ryzen-powered Copilot+ PCs. Handheld play and 1080p support are available, while Performance Mode (up to 120 FPS) and Auto HDR compatibility are rolling out through Windows updates.

item.title: Copilot connector write actions become generally available in Copilot Chat and Cowork
item.description: Microsoft: Copilot connector write actions are now generally available in Copilot Chat and Cowork. Users can ask Copilot to create, update, or delete information in connected applications, review the proposed action, and approve it before execution.

item.title: Microsoft paper reports Copilot harness results for complex task execution
item.description: Microsoft: A Microsoft Copilot Studio Blog paper reports that the Microsoft Copilot harness scored 65% against 36% for a leading competitor on a business-process benchmark. It also says telemetry-driven, one-tool-at-a-time tuning raised the Excel Online connector’s success rate from 85.6% to 96.3% without maker action, highlighting work on agent task execution and reliability.

item.title: Edge 157 upgrades the Copilot new tab page and Copilot experience
item.description: Microsoft: Edge 157 adds an upgraded Copilot new tab page that brings search, chat, and web exploration together, with suggested actions and curated work content. Microsoft also updated the Copilot entry points and side pane, including upgraded Copilot Voice and Vision functionality.

item.title: Microsoft brings GPT-5.6 and expanded Copilot app integration to government clouds
item.description: Microsoft: Microsoft announced expanded Copilot capabilities for U.S. Government cloud customers, including GPT-5.6 in GCC, GCC-H, and DoD and editing with Copilot in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint across those environments. A simplified, chat-centered Copilot app design is available in GCC and GCC-H, with DoD availability to follow.

item.title: SharePoint tools in Work IQ enter public preview for agents
item.description: Microsoft: Microsoft opened a public preview of more than 60 native SharePoint operations through Work IQ, allowing agents to find, understand, create, organize, and share SharePoint content. The tools are also rolling out to Copilot Studio, expanding the SharePoint work agents can perform.

item.title: Microsoft plans locked-down Copilot Chat mode for Study and Learn
item.description: Microsoft: Microsoft is preparing an IT-controlled mode that locks Copilot Chat to the Study and Learn Agent, designed for educational settings. Students would not be able to switch to general Copilot Chat or other agents, while still being able to add their own files as references.

item.title: Estée Lauder expands Copilot access to more than 14,000 employees
item.description: Estée Lauder Companies: Estée Lauder expanded Microsoft Copilot access across its office-based global workforce of more than 14,000 people. The deployment is part of a broader effort to bring Microsoft AI and cloud tools into the company’s business operations.

item.title: Microsoft’s October Copilot roundup details product and admin updates
item.description: Microsoft: Microsoft’s October Copilot roundup highlights updates across Cowork, SharePoint, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, and administration. Among the changes are role-based Cowork plugins and a task catalog, a SharePoint knowledge base, Excel accounting skills, and Insights Agent capabilities for analyzing agent usage and feedback; some features are rolling out globally in November.

item.title: Microsoft expands Copilot with finance skills and partner-built plugins
item.description: Microsoft: Microsoft announced more than 25 finance skills and partner-built plugins for accounting, capital markets, and other finance work. Accounting capabilities in Copilot in Excel and Cowork are available in Frontier, while the Capital Markets and Finance plugins for Cowork are generally available; Dynamics 365 ERP and partner plugins are beginning to roll out.

item.title: Copilot in SharePoint adds generally available image, analytics, and metadata tools
item.description: Microsoft: Microsoft says advanced Copilot in SharePoint capabilities are now generally available, including image generation and editing, AI-generated site analytics reports, and near-real-time metadata autofill. The features use Copilot Credits and are available to Copilot-licensed users, adding new AI-assisted workflows across SharePoint sites and document libraries.

item.title: Microsoft details five new Copilot in Excel capabilities
item.description: Microsoft: Microsoft’s October Excel update adds five Copilot capabilities, including tools to clean and retrieve data, create reusable skills, and work with an interactive canvas. Availability varies: some skills are rolling out generally, while the interactive canvas remains an Insider feature for Windows.

item.title: Microsoft expands Frontier previews to Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Teams
item.description: Microsoft: Starting in November, Frontier will offer eligible public previews across Copilot, new Outlook for Windows, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Teams through one optional, admin-controlled enrollment program. This gives organizations a centralized way to test preview features and provide feedback; users still need licenses for the products they access.

item.title: Microsoft details mobilezone’s deployment of three Copilot Studio agents
item.description: Microsoft and mobilezone: Microsoft reported that mobilezone built three Copilot Studio agents for store monitoring, sales order creation, and product creation. The store-monitoring agent helps a four-person IT support team query device information and investigate errors proactively, illustrating a live operational use of Copilot Studio agents.

item.title: Viva Glint previews Copilot Results Summarization for early November
item.description: Microsoft: Microsoft announced a planned private preview of Results Summarization in Viva Glint Copilot Chat for early November. The experience brings survey scores and comment analysis together conversationally, with permissions and confidentiality safeguards continuing to apply.

item.title: Microsoft introduces the Power Platform Admin plugin for Copilot Cowork
item.description: Microsoft: Microsoft introduced the Power Platform Admin plugin for Copilot Cowork, letting IT administrators ask natural-language questions grounded in tenant-specific Power Platform data. The post describes using those findings to produce audience-specific summaries and governance reports.
